name: freakui
description: Build a native app for iPhone, iPad, and Mac from one prompt, with a unique, handcrafted interface that stands apart from generic apps.

interface.shortDescription: Build a native app for iPhone, iPad, and Mac from one prompt, with a unique, handcrafted interface that stands apart from generic apps.
interface.longDescription: Build a single-target, multi-platform native Swift application for iPhone, iPad, and macOS from one prompt. FreakUI establishes a robust clean architecture foundation with dependency injection, programmatic navigation, MVVM, and platform-specific root views. Its custom theme initialization, precision-focused components, utilities, and extensions give the interface a distinct and consistent identity. Beyond project creation, dedicated FreakUI skills help shape interface sections, add components, and evolve the interface as the app grows.
defaultPrompt: Create a multiplatform app with FreakUI.
Replace this SwiftUI view with FreakUI components.
